system.description:
Once per rest, spend a Hope to coat
yourself in razor mesh, reactive thorns,
or defensive nanofibers and place a
number of tokens equal to your
Interface trait on this card.
When you take damage, you can spend
any number of tokens to roll that
number of d6s. Add the results
together and reduce the incoming
damage by that amount.
If you’re within Melee range of the
attacker, deal that amount of damage
back to them. When you take a rest,
clear all unspent tokens.
